note: Rows describe gateway ARCHETYPES, not vendor scorecards. Named products are listed as examples of the archetype only; verify every cell against the vendor's own documentation for your account before relying on it.

dimensions.label: Credential model
dimensions.question: How many keys does the caller manage?

dimensions.label: Response normalisation
dimensions.question: Is the response shape normalised across providers?

dimensions.label: Billing unit
dimensions.question: Which unit does the caller pay in?

dimensions.label: Retry safety
dimensions.question: Is there an idempotency mechanism for submit retries?

dimensions.label: Timeout control
dimensions.question: Can the caller set request and job TTLs?

dimensions.label: Self-hostable
dimensions.question: Can it run inside your own infrastructure?

dimensions.label: Ops burden
dimensions.question: Who runs upgrades, scaling and incident response?
